stories.title: Sudan: Mindestens 72 Tote bei Luftangriff auf Goldmine an Grenze zu Ägypten

en.title: Sudan: At least 72 dead in airstrike on gold mine at border with Egypt
en.summary: Human rights activists reported that at least 72 people were killed in an airstrike on a gold mine at the Egypt-Sudan border. Egyptian air forces were identified as responsible for the attack.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Trump überrascht mit »Energiewaffenruhe« zwischen Russland und Ukraine

en.title: Donald Trump: Trump surprises with 'energy weapons ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
en.summary: US President Trump announced an 'energy weapons ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated he had no prior knowledge but indicated his country's readiness for such an arrangement.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien: Huthis greifen erneut Flughäfen mit Raketen an

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Houthis attack airports again with rockets
en.summary: The Houthi militia from Yemen conducted another attack on Saudi Arabian airports and energy facilities using rockets. Authorities reported injuries at King Khalid airport.

stories.title: Goldmine zwischen Ägypten und Sudan: Mindestens 72 Tote nach Angriff auf Goldmine

en.title: Gold mine between Egypt and Sudan: At least 72 dead after attack on gold mine
en.summary: According to human rights activists, the Egyptian air force struck a gold mine at the Sudan border, resulting in significant casualties. Egypt did not issue a public statement regarding the incident.

stories.title: Ägypten unter Verdacht: Dutzende Tote bei Luftangriff auf Goldmine in Sudan

en.title: Egypt under suspicion: Dozens killed in airstrike on goldmine in Sudan
en.summary: An airstrike on a goldmine in Sudan has killed 72 workers according to human rights activists. Additional casualties are suspected among the rubble.

stories.title: Krieg in der Golfregion: Tote bei Angriff auf Flughafen von Riad

en.title: War in the Gulf region: Deaths in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport in the Gulf region has resulted in fatalities.

stories.title: Keisuke Goto köpft SC Freiburg gegen Schalke an die Spitze

en.title: Keisuke Goto heads SC Freiburg to the top against Schalke
en.summary: SC Freiburg defeated Schalke 04 with a late goal from substitute Keisuke Goto. Freiburg tops the table after matchday five.

stories.title: US-Präsident Trump teilt angebliche "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Ukraine und Russland mit

en.title: US President Trump announces alleged "energy ceasefire" between Ukraine and Russia
en.summary: US President Trump announces an alleged ceasefire on energy infrastructure attacks between Ukraine and Russia.

stories.title: Trump meldet "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Russland und Ukraine

en.title: Trump reports "energy ceasefire" between Russia and Ukraine
en.summary: U.S. President Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on his Truth Social platform. Neither Kyiv nor Moscow has confirmed the announcement so far.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: Trump ordnet »Energie-Waffenruhe« an – kurz darauf meldet Selenskyj neue Angriffe

en.title: Ukraine war: Trump orders "energy ceasefire" – shortly after Selenskyj reports new attacks
en.summary: US President Trump announces a halt to energy infrastructure attacks in the Ukraine conflict, but Ukrainian President Selenskyj denies knowledge of this agreement and reports a new attack on a heating power plant.

en.title: Ukraine War News Blog: Trump announces "energy ceasefire"
en.summary: U.S. President Trump posted that Russia and Ukraine agreed to an arrangement on Truth Social without providing details. Ukrainian President Zelensky stated he was unaware of any such agreement, and Moscow has not yet responded.

stories.title: Naher Osten: Angriffe auf saudische Flughäfen in Riad und Dammam

en.title: Middle East: Attacks on Saudi airports in Riyadh and Dammam
en.summary: The international airport in Riyadh was attacked again, forcing suspension of flight operations. Saudi Arabia has suspended in-person classes until Thursday.

en.title: +++ Ukraine war +++: Trump reports "energy ceasefire" – Selenskyj surprised
en.summary: Drone alerts reported at Moscow airports with flight operations halted; the US threatens to stop weapon deliveries to Ukraine; Selenskyj reports a new Russian attack on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Künstliche Intelligenz: BMW plant mit KI-basiertem Geschäftsmodell Milliardeneinsparungen

en.title: Artificial Intelligence: BMW plans billion-euro savings with AI-based business model
en.summary: BMW aims to become an AI-orchestrated company by 2028, implementing autonomous agents in procurement operations to achieve significant cost reductions.

stories.title: Ukrainekrieg: „Zusätzliche Einnahmen, um den Krieg zu finanzieren“ – das bedeutet Trumps Diesel-Deal für Europa

en.title: Ukraine War: "Additional revenues to finance the war" – what Trump's diesel deal means for Europe
en.summary: The US President suspended sanctions on Russian diesel imports and demands the resignation of Ukraine's leader, leaving Europe without influence over the decision.

stories.title: Kolumne Inside America: Kleine zahlen, Große lobbyieren: New Yorks Müll-Revolution

en.title: Column Inside America: The small pay, the big lobby: New York's waste revolution
en.summary: New York monitors citizens' garbage disposal, while major corporations like Amazon and Kraft Heinz successfully resist paying for their packaging waste disposal.
